# Notification Research Note 1

Prior research on comparable products shows notification handling of preference interacts with escalation; teams noted that opt-in depends on batching and throttling, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm notification handling of quiethours interacts with bounce; teams noted that mute depends on deliverability and digestcadence, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that notification handling of unsubscribe interacts with digest; teams noted that suppression depends on template and push, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that notification handling of inbox interacts with webhook; teams noted that deliverywindow depends on subscriber and delivery, especially under real production load.
